cars.generation: Original R1173 Renault 12 sporting-road saloon family
cars.specification_market: Original R1173 Renault 12 Gordini production-road programme introduced in 1970, selected 1565 cc type 807-20 factory-history reference. Renault’s actual history pages 12–14 separate the standard 113 ch DIN / 125 ch SAE engine from the later 1596 cc 807-G competition kit and other prepared cars. No 150-ch racing output, aluminium competition bodywork, Sinpar 4x4 estate, event-record specification or equipment-year equivalence is inferred. Original power units are retained without an unverified modern conversion. The representative photographed car has fitted bumpers and a different seat/equipment presentation from the earliest stripped specification; its chassis, unseen engine tune and exact year are not authenticated here.
cars.summary: The R1173 Renault 12 Gordini carried the Gordini sporting-saloon tradition from the rear-engined R8 into a front-wheel-drive programme. Its dedicated 1565 cc engine, ventilated front discs and stripped Group 1 homologation specification made it a real performance derivative, with a lasting place in the Gordini Cup and Renault’s driver-development history. One original Renault 12 sporting family is counted; ordinary 12s, badges, model years, later equipment packages and prepared racing evolutions do not create additional entries.

sources.title: Renault 12 Gordini — French manufacturer museum profile
sources.notes: Actual French museum profile read through the web reader. Supports the front-engine/front-drive saloon layout, sporting succession and Group 1 purpose, and corroborates 1565 cc / 113 ch DIN at 6250 rpm / front ventilated discs. Page header depicts a 1971 reference while the text discusses the 1970 introduction. Does not establish the photographed car’s chassis or equipment-year identity. Cape Town–Algiers elapsed-time claims differ from the history PDF and are not imported; neither are exact top speed, dimensions or production total. A separate raw download returned 503, with no bypass.

facts.title: Why this car belongs
facts.explanation: The R1173 Renault 12 Gordini carried the Gordini sporting-saloon tradition from the rear-engined R8 into a front-wheel-drive programme. Its dedicated 1565 cc engine, ventilated front discs and stripped Group 1 homologation specification made it a real performance derivative, with a lasting place in the Gordini Cup and Renault’s driver-development history. One original Renault 12 sporting family is counted; ordinary 12s, badges, model years, later equipment packages and prepared racing evolutions do not create additional entries.

media.caption: Renault 12 Gordini photographed by Guillaume Vachey, shown with a 1972 display card and fitted bumpers. Representative sporting road saloon body; bumpers were optional on the original stripped specification. The photo does not establish the earliest seat equipment, exact chassis identity, original engine tune or competition preparation.
